title.description: Comparison card title, e.g. '选择第三章开篇风格' or '选择登录页 UI 方案'.

prompt.description: Optional brief guidance shown above the candidates.

expected_count.description: Emit BEFORE `candidates`. Total number of candidates you are about to generate (2-6), so the UI can show placeholder loading slots immediately.

candidate_titles.description: Optional. Emit BEFORE `candidates`. Ordered short titles for each planned candidate so loading placeholders display meaningful labels before content arrives.

layout.description: Initial layout: 'tabs' for long text/full pages, 'split' for side-by-side comparison, 'grid' for compact cards/images.

allow_feedback.description: Allow user to attach an optional refinement note when confirming or rejecting.

title.description: Short display title of this version.

type.description: Renderer format. Use html for a self-contained page; use artifact for a workspace project with its entry and companion files.

content.description: Inline content (markdown/text/html or base64/data URL image).

url.description: Local absolute file path (preferred for large HTML/text/images written via write_file) or URL.

language.description: Optional code language when type='text' or artifact hint.

artifact_key.description: Required when type='artifact'. Relative artifact key under current conversation artifact workspace.

entry_file.description: Required for artifact. Entry path relative to the project root identified by artifact_key; keep sibling modules, styles, assets and project configuration in that root.
